checks: Exact independent Git write-tree SHA and unchanged executable/symlink/submodule/original siblings
Historical 256 KiB checkpoint blob genuinely absent before and after staging and audit PACK pushes
Frozen parent only reachable through advanced remote HEAD; push.negotiate=true excludes server parent closure
Implicit fetch disabled via GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH and remote.origin.promisor=false; advanced-HEAD test also omits environment variable
Current UTC immutable per-role commit journal; exact author/message/parent/tree retained across restart
Exact tree/parent staging reuse, including differing staging commit metadata
Existing conflicting branches and main refs rejected without overwrite
Absent-ref --force-with-lease=<ref>: plus --atomic rejects concurrent even fast-forwardable branch creation
Lost successful push response reconciled with exact remote SHA
Ephemeral 0700 askpass reads env-only token; no token in argv, config, script, journals, cache or local command environments
Wrong bases, missing blobs, malformed paths, part/root mismatch and credential URLs fail closed
Bounded read_blob fetches only an exact missing blob proven in an already verified local commit tree, with --no-filter --no-tags --no-write-fetch-head; no arbitrary commit/history fetch
Blob type and 48 MiB maximum size checked before content read; raw size and Git SHA checked before return; commit raw Git SHA checked before parsing
Base/cache/journal symlinks refused; generic TOKEN/PAT/SECRET/CREDENTIAL environment entries stripped
limitations: The test executes local Git servers; actual GitHub/Colab authentication and transfer are deliberately unexecuted.
scope: Offline local file:// bare-Git remotes only; no GitHub/HTTP, model fits, or scientific source/state/output modifications
